About Shalom Controls

Shalom Controls is an industrial instrumentation and automation sales and service company based in Mettur, Salem District, Tamil Nadu, India.

We support industrial customers with instrument and valve supply, servicing, erection and commissioning, and service manpower requirements.

  • Industrial instrumentation sales and servicing
  • Control valve, MOV actuator and safety valve support
  • Instrumentation erection and commissioning
  • Servicing manpower supply
